content.note: Factors for VTE important for assessing risk of recurrence and decision-making on chronic anticoagulation; table modified from Rogers et al. and Anderson and Spencer.
strong_risk_factors_(OR_>_10): Hospitalization for heart failure or atrial fibrillation/flutter (within previous 3 months)
moderate_risk_factors_(OR_2-9): Congestive heart failure or respiratory failure
